column1: # Rows db.evnan.tn.* (line RG, X-evalue-nan, 2026-11-28): tblastn `-evalue -nan` and `+inf`: Spouge's cutoff 0 without -searchsp (blast_stat.c:5236-5269), the reaps that drop an HSP only when its e-value is greater than -evalue (blast_hits.c:1976-2003; NaN keeps every HSP), the composition-based redo's test of the best e-value (blast_kappa.c:3687; NaN keeps no match), sum statistics off and a PSSM query. tab_tbn_q.faa and ps7_ts1_tslice.asn.gz against tslice, outfmt 6.

column12: X-evalue-nan: Spouge's cutoff 0, every HSP kept (LOSAT kept none)
X-evalue-nan: the composition-based redo keeps no match (LOSAT kept every match)
X-evalue-nan: no linking, BLAST_Cutoffs' cutoff 1, every HSP kept
X-evalue-nan: an infinite -evalue without the redo (refused before)
X-evalue-nan: a PSSM query (no redo for -in_pssm), every HSP kept
